authority: User explicitly requested bid/ask average for both paper option buys and sells; use valid supplied midpoint when present.
fill_and_mark_basis: Provider mid/midpoint/mid_price/midpoint_price when finite inside spread and nonconflicting; otherwise (bid+ask)/2.
last_trade: Retain as reference when supplied; never substitute last for midpoint.
scope: All simulated option entries, exits, rolls and equity marks in V7; same reference price convention on both sides.
costs: Existing fee 0.10% and slippage 0.05% per side remain separate deductions.
unchanged_stock_execution: Funded physical exercise and observed Alpaca stock liquidation retain their existing stock execution policy.
historical_artifacts: Preserve prior ask/bid artifacts as superseded; rebuild option labels/marks/portfolios and source-bound stages, never relabel old prices.
